close_reason: Doc comment added to query_objects explaining negative position semantics
description: The MailBackend::query_objects position: i64 parameter has no doc comment explaining whether backends must handle negative values (relative-to-end semantics, per RFC 8620 §5.5). In Email/query with collapseThreads=false, the raw client-supplied negative position is passed through to the backend. In the collapseThreads=true path, the handler resolves it first. A backend implementor writing the non-collapsed path will not know from the trait signature alone that they must implement negative-position semantics. Add a doc comment to query_objects saying: 'position may be negative — negative values are relative to the end of the result set per RFC 8620 §5.5; backends MUST handle this.'
title: query_objects position parameter missing negative-value contract doc
